China deploys J-20 fighter jets near LAC, India assesses response

China has deployed 11 J-20 stealth fighter jets near the Line of Actual Control (LAC) with India, according to satellite imagery. The J-20 is described as a potent weapon system. India is reportedly assessing potential responses, with discussions involving the capabilities of its S-400 air defense systems and Rafale fighter jets.
